services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Enjoy a magical evening aboard our vessel as it glides to the perfect spot to watch HarborWalk Village’s spectacular Thursday night fireworks show. You’ll be surrounded by shimmering emerald waters and the best unobstructed views of the sky bursting with color. With music, good vibes, and a cozy atmosphere, this is your VIP ticket to an unforgettable night. Ideal for families, couples, and groups of friends looking for a festive night out. Kids love the lights and excitement, and adults get to unwind away from crowded beaches and noisy streets. services.name: Dolphin cruis
services.desc: Hop aboard our vessel and get ready to cruise the stunning waters of Destin, where dolphins love to play in the surf and show off just a few feet from the boat. Our Coast Guard-certified captains know all the best spots around the East Pass, Choctawhatchee Bay, and the Gulf of America, and they’ll take you on a relaxing, scenic journey you won’t forget. These playful creatures often swim right alongside us, leaping, twirling, and riding our wake. Whether you’re a first-timer or a dolphin cruise veteran, every trip with Destin Snorkel is a brand-new adventure.
